response.rationale: Both answers accurately express “service fee.” Indonesian biaya layanan is semantically appropriate and attested in ordinary usage; Malaysian caj perkhidmatan is a standard equivalent. The different-common-word relation is correct. No false-friend contrast is present; tarif layanan and yuran perkhidmatan are contextual alternatives, not contradictions.
